# Headerless Pipe Tables

## Basic Headerless Table

| A | B |
| 1 | 2 |
| 3 | 4 |

## Delimiter-Looking Data Row

| --- | --- |
| A | B |
| 1 | 2 |

## Headerless Table Without Edge Pipes

A | B | C
1 | 2 | 3
long left value | long middle value that wraps in narrow output | long right value

## Headerless Table With Inline Content

| **strong value** | [link value](https://example.com) |
| `code value` | escaped \| pipe |
| plain value | *emphasis value* |
